name: The Knight's Forge
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine
waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
artProps: Layout copied from keepers-hall. Theme and props from the forge-of-courage draft room "knights-forge". A huge round forge with a glowing mouth; the Ember Knight stands before it with a raised shield.
signs: A calm heart is a strong heart.
